lead.headline: Wichita State takes over the American
lead.deck: The Shockers won three times, including 85-60 over New Mexico, and moved up to first in our power rankings. Memphis is ranked in the AP poll. The model likes the Shockers more.
body: Wichita State was a 2-point underdog at home to New Mexico on Friday and won by 25. Jahari Long scored 22 and Jordan Frison had 16 points and eight assists. Three days earlier the Shockers won 79-75 at Loyola Chicago behind William Berg's 27 points and nine rebounds. Then they beat Texas A&M-Corpus Christi 91-73. The conference named Berg its player of the week.
That moves Wichita State from third to first in the power rankings. At 6-1 they have the league's best record, and at 60th nationally, plus-15.7 per 100 possessions, the best rating in our model too.

Memphis is 4-1, 24th in the AP poll according to Local Memphis, and second in our power rankings. The Tigers beat Evansville 82-62 but didn't cover 20.5. The model has them 67th. It also rates their schedule the hardest in the league by a mile, which is why the poll likes them. They play at Penn State this afternoon.
South Florida lost 73-62 at George Mason, then beat Stetson 100-67. The Bulls dropped one spot, to third.
The American went 14-13 this week. A league that wants three bids can't keep splitting its weeks down the middle.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: One big afternoon, then the holiday
body: **Memphis at Penn State, today, 5 p.m.** Memphis is a 3.5-point favorite and the total is 163, the highest of any American game on the board. A road win here would help the Tigers more than any poll vote.
**Tulane at Davidson, today, 1:30 p.m.** The Green Wave are 9.5-point underdogs after losing 74-67 at Louisiana Tech and 73-63 at Georgia State. They've slipped to 11th in the power rankings.
Most of the league's lines for the holiday weekend aren't posted yet. Wichita State and FAU are the two to watch: both moved up in the power rankings this week, FAU from 12th to 10th.

notes.headline: UAB's upset, then a thud
notes.body: Deuce Jones scored 24 and hit the winning layup with 42 seconds left in an 81-76 win at George Washington, as 9-point underdogs. Two days later Rhode Island beat the Blazers 79-64 at UAB.

notes.headline: East Carolina went 0-3
notes.body: The Pirates lost at Utah Valley, then lost at home to Southern Illinois and Indiana State, the last one 77-76 despite 29 points from Trevor Best. They fell from seventh to 13th in the power rankings.

notes.headline: Temple's Cam Scott can score
notes.body: He had 28 in an 85-76 win at Middle Tennessee and 24 in a 72-70 loss at Stephen F. Austin. Then the Owls lost 90-81 at UT Martin, where Davi Remagen scored 31.

notes.headline: Circle it: Memphis at Penn State
notes.body: Today, 5 p.m. ET. Memphis by 3.5, total 163.
